title: How can I obtain a copy of the SOC I Type II or SOC 2 Type II report
text: Please visit https://trust.veson.com/ to request a copy of the latest version of the SOC I Type II or SOC 2 Type II report.

title: How can I set someone as a Security Administrator when the current one is unreachable?
text: It is always best practice to have at least two (2) users assigned with System Administrator permissions. This workflow should only be used when the current security administrator(s) cannot be reached. If your organization finds itself in need of a new Security Admin, follow the steps: Navigate to the Help Center, select Veson Support, file a Licensing Request by providing the following information for the new admin: Name or username, Account email address.

title: How do I change a user's Authentication Type?
text: To change a user's Authentication Type, clients must reach out to Veson Nautical Support for these changes to be made on the administrative side. Please provide: User name, Email address.

title: How do I find out how many licenses we have?
text: Please reach out to your Veson Nautical Account Manager or feel free to submit a ticket through the Help Center.

title: How do I purchase additional users for IMOS?
text: To inquire about adding new users to IMOS, please submit a ticket directly in our Help Center using the License Requests drop-down menu.

title: How do I request a schema update?
text: Sometimes you will need schema updates to activate new features. Schema updates can be requested by IMOS clients or are proactively scheduled by Veson. To request a schema update, create the request through the Help Center via the Product Support option, providing a time slot (specified in UTC). Typically, one hour is adequate, but a two-hour window is requested.

title: How do I request that a test database be refreshed with the latest copy of production?
text: Database refreshes are requested by IMOS clients. On-Premise clients will need to refresh their test database by themselves. To request the database refresh, create the request through the Help Center via the Product Support option. Please expect each database refresh to be completed within a two-hour window.

title: How do I set up a new IMOS user after additional licenses have been added?
text: Once you have been notified that your license change has been completed, your administrator or key user must create the new user directly in your IMOS instance. Follow the instructions for IMOS - Creating a New User.

title: How to decode and check the valid to date of a x509 certificate?
text: The client should provide a zip file (that includes IMOS-Raw.cer file, IMOS-Base64.cer, IMOSFederationMetadata.xml file) or IMOS-Base64.cer file only. Open the file with Notepad++. To check the Valid To date, use: https://certlogik.com/decoder/ Copy and Paste the certificate and click Decode. Check the Valid To date.

title: How to Open Encrypted Emails
text: When our team sends you a sensitive email, it is protected using Microsoft Purview Message Encryption. Outlook 365 Users may be able to double-click the email to open directly. Otherwise: Option 1 - Microsoft Account: Click Read the message, Sign in with Microsoft account. Option 2 - Google Account: Click Sign in with Google. Option 3 - Different Email: Click Sign in with a one-time passcode.

title: IMOS - How to create a TEST-ONLY User
text: As an Admin: 1. Create a user in IMOS Prod with password and set to Authentication only. 2. Create the user in IMOS Test with the access rights and set a password. 3. Please ask the user to log in using the "Test Only" user's email address and password. Authentication-Only users do not use up a license in Production, but they do in Test.

title: IMOS - Troubleshooting slow load performance
text: Standard Tips: Check Internet connectivity. Close some tabs and clear Chrome cache. Use Chrome. Check Task Manager for high CPU/memory usage. For heavy reports: check if propeller is spinning (right-click > inspect), check date range (decrease to one day), refresh browser if blank screen.

title: My IMOS session timed out. How do I recover my work?
text: In most scenarios, IMOS autosaves your work when you navigate between workspaces. For security reasons, if IMOS detects that you have been inactive for 90 minutes, a notification prompts you to refresh your browser without allowing you to save. Refreshing will cause minor data loss of unsaved data in the open workspace.

title: What is the Veson Nautical client Password Policy?
text: All new passwords are required to be a minimum of 12 characters and contain at least one lowercase character, one uppercase character, one digit, and one of the following symbols: ~!@#%&_=;:'<,>-.$^{[(|)]}*+?\\

title: Why can't I see my company's test site?
text: An IMOS user set up with SSO signs in to production first to access test. Common reasons test site doesn't appear: The user is not created in the test environment. There are typos in the user name. The user's email address has unnecessary spaces.
